'''Riilna''' was a [[Cathar/Legends|Cathar]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] who specialized in [[Force empathy/Legends|Force empathy]] and mental control during the [[Galactic War]]. In [[3637 BBY]], the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] participated in the [[Korriban Incursion]] and was killed by an Imperial strike team.
